args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Travel documents (passport/ID, flight tickets, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and accessories
- Medications and first aid kit
- Travel insurance information

Beach & Water Activities:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Beach towels
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Sunglasses
- Beach hat or cap
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel)
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking shoes/boots (for Diamond Head)
- Lightweight hiking clothes
- Rain jacket/light windbreaker
- Water bottle/hydration pack
- Day backpack
- Insect repellent

Clothing:
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable fabrics)
- Light sweater or jacket for evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Dressier outfit for the Luau
- Underwear and socks
- Sleepwear
- Laundry bag

Toiletries:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if needed)
- Moisturizer

Electronics:
- Laptop/tablet (optional)
- Universal power adapter
- Portable power bank
- Headphones

Miscellaneous:
- Books/magazines for downtime
- Travel pillow and eye mask
- Reusable water bottle
- Small daypack for excursions
- Shopping bag for souvenirs
